title: General FAQ
summary: Common questions about playing the game.

blocks.text: Q. Where can I see the current server stage?
A. On the [LINK:roadmap_current|Current Server Stage] page or the [LINK:roadmap_main|Server Roadmap] page.
Q. Where can I see what comes in the next update?
A. The [LINK:roadmap_upcoming|Upcoming Updates] page lists the content and systems planned next.
Q. What happens when I register a costume?
A. Registering a costume in the Costume Album uses up the original item and adds it to the album permanently.
Q. Can my other characters use a registered costume?
A. The character that registered it can use it right away. Unlock the account wardrobe and the other characters on the same account can use it too.
Q. Are Costume Enchant Stones shared across my account?
A. No. Enchant Stones are managed per character and are not shared with other characters.
Q. Can I get a specific costume directly?
A. Yes. Spend 300 Costume Coins to choose and get the costume with the album number you want.
Q. Where do I get Shadow Gear?
A. Shadow Gear will be added step by step through Lucky Eggs.
Q. Will new costumes and Enchant Stones keep coming?
A. Yes. New costumes, Enchant Stones and Shadow Gear will keep being added according to the Server Roadmap.
Q. Do I need to do entry quests for content?
A. Most content on the NEED server is available right away. The Warp Helper takes you there without entry quests.
Q. How do I find information that is not in the wiki?
A. New pages are added all the time. If you cannot find what you need, contact the staff or check back after future updates.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: FAQ answers may change with server updates.
